author: Top Gear
description:
The end of 2026 is upon us, but which is the greatest performance car of the year? To find out, we gathered the best of the best (on sale in Europe, hence no Corvette ZR1X) and drag raced them, lapped them and generally thrashed them on track to find out. Does the Aston Martin Valhalla, Bentley Supersports, Ferrari 296 Speciale or Porsche 911 GT3 S/C win?

🚗 Aston Martin Valhalla, Bentley Supersports, Ferrari 296 Speciale, Porsche 911 GT3 S/C
🎤 Jethro Bovingdon
